literal: Difficult tasks, they say, are there any? If one acts with the proper means, having known the right time.
translation: Are there any tasks said to be impossible, if one acts with the proper means after choosing the right time?
modern: தகுந்த கருவிகளுடன், ஏற்ற காலத்தை அறிந்து ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், செய்ய முடியாத அருமையான செயல்கள் என்று ஏதேனும் உண்டோ?
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of timing and preparation in achieving difficult goals. The author asks rhetorically if there is any task too difficult to accomplish in this world. The answer is no, provided two conditions are met: one must act with the appropriate resources or instruments and perform the action at the most opportune moment. When correct timing and proper means come together, even the most challenging endeavors become easily achievable.
